name: Hecla Mining
outlook:
What Hecla Mining says to expect

  • Full year 2026: silver productionConsolidated silver production is expected to be 15.3-16.1 million ounces, with low end raised compared to prior guidance of 15.1-16.1 million ounces, and Greens Creek's gold production guidance of 51.0-55.0 koz is reiterated.
  • Full year 2026: silver cash cost and AISCTotal silver cash cost and AISC guidance per silver ounce is improved to ($4.75)-($4.25)/oz and $11.50-$12.50/oz respectively.
  • Full year 2026: exploration and pre-developmentExploration and pre-development expenditures, from continuing operations, remain unchanged and are expected to be $55 million, with the focus at Greens Creek and Keno Hill, Nevada and Lucky Friday.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
